title: observability-weekly-2026-09-21
body:
Attendees: Aisha Patel (owner), Diego Morales, Priya Singh, Evan Liu, Marta Kowalska, on-call rotation: Diego

Overview:
- Weekly notes focused on tracing rollout, dashboard refresh, and cost telemetry pipeline work.
- No P0 incidents this week. Two P1-worthy regressions observed in trace sampling which were mitigated with a hotfix.

Standup/high-level updates (by person):
- Aisha: Coordinated tracing rollout plan for internal services; confirmed canary for traces-v2 starts 2026-09-23. Working with Platform to reserve capacity for increased span volume.
- Diego: Investigated relay-backend spike on 2026-09-19 (OBS-342). Root cause: misapplied sampling policy from config sync. Rolled back to stable sampling rules, created JIRA OBS-360 for policy validation and tests.
- Priya: Dashboard refresh nearly complete for model-serving cost dashboard. Reworked token-cost math to include batching efficiency; new panels added for per-model cost/1M tokens and burst vs sustained cost.
- Evan: Cost telemetry pipeline migration to BigQuery staging finished; nightly ETL runs green. Seeing ~8% lower reported cost after correcting for GPU utilization smoothing.
- Marta: Tracing SDK patch landed (PR #128) adding span attributes for model_version and quantization_profile. Will monitor tag cardinality.

Tracing workstream:
- Goal: deploy traces-v2 (higher fidelity, adaptive sampling) to 25% canary on 9/23 and expand to 100% by 10/07 if metrics stable.
- Completed: SDK patch for model metadata, sampling policy service changes merged, e2e test coverage added for sampling policy fallbacks.
- Open risks: potential high-cardinality increase from model_version tags — mitigations: implement tag-rollup and cardinality limit on ingest (diego to own).
- Metrics to watch during canary: spans/sec, ingest-latency (95th), dropped-span-rate, observability storage rate (GB/day).

Dashboards and alerts:
- New cost dashboard panels rolled to staging Grafana: per-model cost/1M tokens, batching efficiency panel, top-10 cost drivers. Feedback requested by product host-api team by 2026-09-25.
- Alert tuning: reduced sensitivity on high-span-count alert to avoid noisy pager for model retrain jobs. Introduced a suppression window for scheduled retrains (weekly jobs).
- Action: Priya to file a dashboard PR with copy changes and panel descriptions by EOD 2026-09-24.

Cost telemetry:
- BigQuery migration status: staging done, production cutover scheduled for 2026-10-01. Nightly ETL job id: cost-etl-v3.
- Observed discrepancy: older pipeline undercounted GPU idle overhead; new pipeline adds a utilization-smoothing factor resulting in +6-9% on some customers. Finance informed; working on customer-facing notes.
- Action: Evan to produce a short doc explaining delta and reconciliation steps for customer success by 2026-09-28.

Incidents and postmortems:
- Relay spike (2026-09-19): mitigated by rollback; postmortem (draft) linked (OBS-342). Root cause: sampling policy sync race condition during config rollout.
- No other incidents that affected customer-facing SLAs. Minor dashboard flapping addressed with alert tuning.

Action items (owner, due):
- Diego: Implement policy-validation tests in config-sync pipeline (OBS-360) — due 2026-09-30.
- Priya: Submit dashboard PR with copy + panel descriptions — due 2026-09-24.
- Evan: Draft customer reconciliation note for cost telemetry delta — due 2026-09-28.
- Marta: Monitor span-cardinality for canary traces-v2 and report weekly — first report due 2026-09-30.
- Aisha: Coordinate platform capacity reservation for canary expansion — due 2026-09-22.

Risks/Blockers:
- High-cardinality tags could increase storage cost and query latency; mitigation: tag-rollup and cardinality caps.
- Platform capacity for canary needs confirmation (Aisha) before 9/23 — otherwise delay.

Notes and questions for leadership:
- Recommend approving temporary increased observability ingest budget (+15%) for canary period to prevent throttles.
- Seek approval for customer communication plan re: cost telemetry delta (Finance + CS review).

Next meeting / cadence:
- Continue weekly rhythm. Next sync: 2026-09-28 (same time).

Quick links:
- Grafana main dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/obs/main-dashboard
- Postmortem draft: JIRA OBS-342
- Tracing RFC: Confluence /pages/viewpage.action?pageId=tracing-rfc
